correctness.rationale: PASS: For real symmetric trace-zero 4x4 B and probability measure on S^3, checked the Gaussian quadratic cumulant expansion, chi-square radial 12th moment, tr B^4 = S^2/2 - 4det B and tr B^6 = S^3/4 -3(det B)S+T^2/3. This yields K=(9/14)(15-144D/S^2+16T^2/S^3). The separate sharp determinant bounds [-1/48,1/16] and |T|^2/S^3 <=1/3 have the simultaneous endpoint spectra described. The Lagrange-multiplier two-level argument rules out other extrema. Quaternionic double cover S^3 -> SO(3) gives the complete 9-dimensional coefficient isometry, including rank-one and scaled-orthogonal equality modes. Independently recomputed the Dirichlet-degree-six invariant polynomial exactly (not just by numerical samples). This does not claim a dimension-free theorem or distance-to-orbit control.
